data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Dhah’ which means ‘bright, shining’, ‘Dahaa’ is a unisex name with deep meanings. It symbolizes brightness, radiance, and illumination, representing the light of knowledge and wisdom. The name Dahaa carries the meaning “Bright, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Dahaa usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
